description: This file defines classes and functions related to the implementation of a recycle view system in Kivy, including behaviors for data views, view caching, and view management within a RecyclerView context.

classes.name: RecycleDataViewBehavior
classes.description: A base class for data views that provides methods for refreshing view attributes, layout, and selection.

classes.name: RecycleKVIDsDataViewBehavior
classes.description: An extension of RecycleDataViewBehavior that supports setting properties of child widgets via data keys with IDs.

classes.name: RecycleDataAdapter
classes.description: A class responsible for converting data into views, managing view caching, and handling view states within a recycle view system.

methods.name: _clean_cache
methods.description: Trims the view cache to half the maximum size.

methods.name: refresh_view_attrs
methods.description: Syncs view attributes with data, excluding size and position.

methods.name: refresh_view_layout
methods.description: Updates the size and layout attributes of a view based on layout data.

methods.name: apply_selection
methods.description: Placeholder method for applying selection state to a view.

methods.name: refresh_view_attrs
methods.description: Overrides to refresh view attributes, supporting setting child widget properties via data keys.

methods.name: attach_recycleview
methods.description: Associates a RecycleView with the adapter.

methods.name: create_view
methods.description: Creates and initializes a view instance for a data item.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Retrieves a view from cache or creates a new one if necessary, marking it as stale if from cache.

methods.name: refresh_view_attrs
methods.description: Syncs a view's attributes with data, calling the appropriate method based on inheritance.

methods.name: refresh_view_layout
methods.description: Updates a view's size and layout attributes.

methods.name: make_view_dirty
methods.description: Marks a view as dirty for reuse.

methods.name: make_views_dirty
methods.description: Marks all current views as dirty for re-layout.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Moves all current views into the global cache, clearing current view states.

methods.name: set_visible_views
methods.description: Determines which views are visible, creating new ones or reusing cached views.

methods.name: get_visible_view
methods.description: Returns the currently visible view for a given index.
